_comment: Example config for acceptance_audit.py. Copy to your repo root as acceptance_audit.json and adapt. Every value here is project-specific; the script itself is not. The values below are taken from a real XZ/LZMA MoonBit project, which is why they mention xz/lzma - replace the commands with your own adapters.
_comment_version: Patterns must capture the stated version. Point them at every place the version appears.
_comment_constants: If the version is duplicated in source, capture it here. Hardcoded copies are what drift.
_comment_counts: Only list files that actually state a count. A README that lists coverage instead of a number needs no entry - and inventing one would leave this permanently UNVERIFIED.
_comment_api: api_reference_pattern captures API names as the docs write them; they are then looked up in the generated interface.
_comment_negative: Each 'not supported' claim, plus the code that would make it false. This is how drift is caught in the direction people forget to check.

negative_claims.text: 不提供逐字节增量接口

_comment_adapters: The four entries below are the project-specific half. Write a small script for each; the skill explains what each must demonstrate.
